content.title: OSHA Fundamentals: Understanding Employer and Employee Responsibilities
content.text: Every workplace has its unique challenges and potential hazards, but the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) ensures that safety is not optional. OSHA’s mission is to save lives, prevent injuries, and maintain a healthy environment for every worker across various industries. This training offers an in-depth look into the origins of OSHA, its regulations, and its life-saving contributions to workplace safety. Whether you're an employer wanting to understand your compliance obligations or an employee eager to know your rights, this course provides essential insights. This course delves into the standards that OSHA enforces, from fall prevention and chemical handling to the provision of personal protective equipment (PPE) and noise mitigation. Gain knowledge about OSHA's General Duty Clause and how its enforcement holds employers accountable for creating hazard-free workplaces. Learn how employees can report violations without fear of retaliation and how you can contribute to safer work environments. Understanding OSHA's role isn’t just about compliance—it’s about protecting lives and fostering a culture of care.
